types.name: Grid
types.description: A short, intense class that mixes high-intensity intervals, functional fitness and mobility. You push, pull, squat, hinge, twist and lunge to build strength, burn energy and move better. All levels; bring a towel and water.

types.name: Lift Club
types.description: A 45-minute barbell strength class for all levels. You learn safe lifting technique and build strength and muscle, in 6-week blocks so you can see your progress, and you can join at any time. Bring a towel and water.

types.name: Hyrox
types.description: Training for HYROX fitness racing through Virgin Active's HYROX partnership. Structured, progressive sessions build your running, strength and endurance on the race stations: SkiErg, sled push and pull, burpee broad jumps, rowing, farmer's carry, sandbag lunges and wall balls.
